source.place: Tags 0GMW and 0FPQ: normalized pure tensors, total tensor summands, and signed coherence.

title: Normalized clopen tensor comparison through the differential clause

from.place: Strictly smaller prefix retaining the common braided and total comparison witness.

statement: For each component of a finite disjoint clopen pro-etale cover, there are a braided restriction and total comparison satisfying the pure-tensor, total-summand, and differential formulas.

proof.text: Apply clopen_ordinary_tensor_normalization to the clopen immersion j i. Retain its braided structure h and its normalized pure-tensor equation. This is the only remaining sheaf-level construction.

The first clause of clopen_structural_coproduct_adjunction gives preservation of all coefficient-sized coproducts. Apply it to a ULift of the integer total-degree fibre and transport across Discrete.equivalence Equiv.ulift. This supplies precisely the coproduct-preservation instances needed by mapHomologicalComplexδNatTrans.

Construct b by applying Functor.uncurry.mapIso to asIso of the canonical mapBifunctorComparisonNatTrans (the underlying construction of mapHomologicalComplexδNatTrans) induced by the ordinary inverse tensorator. Strongness and coproduct preservation make it invertible. map_ιMapBifunctor_mapBifunctorComparisonX gives its formula on each total summand. All complexes are unbounded and use the existing coefficientTotalTensor.

Expand the restriction functor on a composite and use the chain-map equation for b to move the differential to the target total complex. Rewrite by the summand normalization. The remaining equation is exactly CochainComplex.ιTensorObj_d on the restricted complexes, which has terms dP tensor id and (-1)^p id tensor dQ. This proves the signed differential clause without another comparison axiom.

theorem clopen_structural_comparison_prefix
    (X : Scheme.{t}) (I : Type w) [Finite I] (Y : I → Scheme.{t})
    (j : ∀ i, Y i ⟶ X) [∀ i, IsOpenImmersion (j i)] [∀ i, IsClosedImmersion (j i)]
    (hdisjoint : Pairwise (fun i k ↦ Disjoint (Set.range (j i)) (Set.range (j k))))
    (hcover : ∀ x : X, ∃ i, x ∈ Set.range (j i))
    (R : Sheaf (topology X) CommRingCat.{max u (t + 1)}) :
    ∀ i, ∃ (h : (ClopenData.clopenTensorRestriction.{t, u} (j i) R).Braided)
      (b : coefficientTotalTensor.{u, t + 1, t} (topology X) R ⋙
          ClopenData.clopenTensorComplexRestriction.{t, u} (j i) R ≅
        ((ClopenData.clopenTensorComplexRestriction.{t, u} (j i) R).prod
          (ClopenData.clopenTensorComplexRestriction.{t, u} (j i) R)) ⋙
            coefficientTotalTensor.{u, t + 1, t} (topology (Y i))
              ((ClopenData.clopenTensorRings.{t, u} (j i)).obj R)),
      clopenStructuralPrefix i h b
